author: mwongj
release_notes: Performance fix for full rescans and series generation on large libraries, preserving the stable 1.21.1 behavior. Finding an episode's existing managed path scanned every tracked series file once per episode (about 44 ms per lookup with ~50k tracked files, growing with library size); it now starts from the indexed provider source and takes about 0.6 ms with identical results. Covered by a query-plan regression test; 497 tests pass. Existing settings, plugin identity and prior release packages are preserved. Large first-time syncs still fetch missing provider metadata once; cached evidence never expires.
